subject: general
question: Which one of the following passes connects the last south-eastern end of Spiti valley with Shailkhar and Chango of Hagarag valley in Kinnaur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**lepcha la.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lepcha la** connects the last south-eastern end of **Spiti valley with Shailkhar and Chango of Hagarag valley in Kinnaur**.
 
• Lepcha La Pass connects** the extreme southeastern end of the Spiti valley with Shailkhar and Chango of the Hangrang Valley in Kinnaur.**
